page_title: Non-Invasive Device Security for Teams - Pareto Security

sources.entry: ParetoSecurity - A MenuBar app to automatically audit your Mac for basic security hygiene. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ParetoSecurity/pareto-mac)

summary.name: Pareto Security
summary.one_liner: Pareto Security is a read-only device security checker that audits Macs, Windows, and Linux laptops for settings like disk encryption, updates, firewall, and screen lock, with cloud reporting for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence.
use_cases: prove remote laptops are encrypted and patched for SOC 2
check personal (BYOD) laptops without taking them over
verify contractor machines before granting access
generate ISO 27001 or Cyber Essentials device evidence
monitor team device security drift with email or Slack alerts
audit a Mac for basic security hygiene
summary.what_it_does:
Pareto runs a set of 30+ checks on each device covering disk encryption, automatic updates, firewall, screen lock and auto-lock, and sharing or remote-access settings. It is described as read-only: it reads security settings and does not access personal files, browsing, or change settings. Linked devices report to Pareto Cloud, which shows status across the team, sends alerts when a device drifts (by email or Slack), and offers one-click fixes. Cloud reports are presented as audit-ready evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS, and Cyber Essentials. The desktop app is stated to be open source on GitHub.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Read-only, open-source desktop app that checks settings rather than files or activity
Works on personal and contractor laptops without enrollment, unlike an MDM
Free for up to 5 devices via Pareto Cloud; desktop app is free and open source
Audit-ready reports for SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS, and Cyber Essentials
caveats: Paid plans required for larger teams and for compliance reporting and historical evidence
Covers the device portion of compliance frameworks only, not the whole program
Not an MDM and not antivirus or EDR
